Team — attaching the proposed OKR slate for the quarter and a first-pass QBR checklist for the Acme pilot. Key asks in this thread:

1) Owners: confirm you can own the objective by EOD Friday (5/16).
2) Metrics: Marcus, can you attach measurement rubrics where available?
3) Pre-QBR: Jane asked for a 30-min dry run the week before the QBR; propose Thu 5/29 10:00 PT.
4) Legal/procurement: Aditya to confirm any procurement gating items that could affect launch timing.

Attachments: Q1_OKR_proposal.xlsx (objectives + owners), contract-schedule.pdf (timeline & procurement milestones)

High-level objectives (summary):
- Objective A: Reduce inference token cost by 18% for live workloads (owner: kimberly_park)
- Objective B: Stabilize 99th percentile latency across Redwood Dedicated by 25ms (owner: marcus_lin)
- Objective C: Customer enablement: Acme pilot integration and initial usage ramp (owner: lauren_bishop)

Please reply with acceptance / redlines / blockers. I will consolidate and escalate outstanding asks to the exec QBR prep on Monday.

—Maya
